subject: [PATCH v4 13/21] block: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the block iomap operations to use a new callback function, ->iomap_next(), which is generated by the DEFINE_IOMAP_ITER_NEXT() macro. This change does not introduce any functional changes and is part of a larger series of patches. The new callback simplifies the process of generating the next mapping in an I/O operation.
